items.note: CHI system paper: user study (N=16) compares the CreativeConnect generative-AI recombination tool with a baseline without generative pipelines; outcomes are number of design ideas and self-reported creativity, so the only output measure is an idea count; below 50 participants.

CHI EA system paper: user study (N=8) compares the Expandora LLM prompt-variation tool with a baseline text-to-image interface; outcomes are prompt diversity, number of prompts and satisfaction (exploration process, not rated output); very small and could be judged system_paper or no output outcome at full text.

AOM proceedings abstract: 2x2 between-subjects online experiment (AI- vs colleague-generated example ideas x early vs late exposure) with 233 participants; novelty and feasibility of generated ideas scored; the AI arm is exposure to AI-generated examples rather than interactive AI use.

AOM proceedings abstract: two experiments vary the stage (early vs late) of generative-AI use in idea generation; novelty and feasibility of ideas measured; sample sizes not given; possibly related to c747 (same author group).

Conference poster (no abstract; read the poster PDF): 100 FAT and 101 DAT participants did an association task solo then with an AI agent (fixed order) and the AUT pre and post; originality and variability scored with semantic-distance measures; within-person, non-randomized order, poster only.

Randomized lab experiment in which undergraduates write an analytical essay with or without generative AI and then unaided one week later; abstract reports essay quality, not similarity (search notes report a near-zero pairwise-cosine homogenization effect, N=211); co-authored by the atlas owner, and the task is analytical rather than creative writing.

AOM proceedings abstract: controlled lab experiments with entrepreneurs vary level of AI use and prior sector knowledge; AI reportedly constrains creativity and novelty in opportunity recognition; the AI tool is not named, so it may not be generative AI; sample size not given.

119 participants wrote an open-ended response in Google Docs with Smart Compose enabled (55) or disabled (59); no significant quantitative or qualitative effect on writing; abstract taken from the companion Ole Miss thesis since the Springer chapter abstract was unreachable; whether creativity or similarity is measured and whether Smart Compose counts as generative AI need full-text checks.

Novice and expert designers created UI/UX designs with Galileo AI or Figma; creativity rated with the Creative Product Semantic Scale (Figma higher), plus NASA-TLX and time; group sizes and assignment not stated in the abstract.

CHI paper: qualitative studies with fashion-design apprentices compare the generative.fashion graphical design-space tool with a text-prompt Stable Diffusion interface (AI vs AI configuration), plus two follow-up quantitative studies; whether output creativity is scored and the sample sizes are unknown.
